entities.summary: Max Feldbauer (1869–1948) was a German painter, associated with the Munich Secession. He is primarily known for rural, Bavarian scenes. Max Feldbauer was a authors & novelists from Neumarkt in der Oberpfalz (1869-02-14, Neumarkt in der Oberpfalz–1948-11-20). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
